mailServicePolicy.title: Mail Service Policy
mailServicePolicy.intro: This Mail Service Policy describes how {owner} ({siteName}) uses email services on {siteUrl}, including email sent through Google Gmail and related Google application credentials. This policy applies to visitors who submit the contact form, subscribe to updates, or otherwise communicate with us by email.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: {siteName} operates a portfolio website at {siteUrl}. Email is used only to support legitimate site operations: responding to contact inquiries, sending transactional confirmations, and delivering newsletter content to subscribers who opt in. We do not use email for unsolicited bulk messaging or advertising on behalf of third parties.

provider.title: 2. Mail service provider
provider.body: Outbound and notification email for this website is delivered using Google Gmail through an authorized Google application (Gmail API / app credentials). Google processes message transmission on our behalf in accordance with Google's terms and privacy policies. {siteName} remains the data controller for information you submit through this site.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of email use
purposes.body:
We use email to:
• Notify {owner} when a visitor submits the contact form.
• Send an automated confirmation to the sender after a contact form submission.
• Send welcome and update messages to newsletter subscribers who provide consent.
• Respond manually to inquiries when follow-up is required.

We do not use email data for unrelated profiling, resale, or third-party marketing.

data_collected.title: 4. Information collected
data_collected.body:
Depending on how you interact with the site, we may process:
• Your name and email address (contact form or newsletter signup).
• Subject line and message content you provide.
• Technical metadata necessary to deliver email (timestamps, delivery status).

We do not request or store Gmail mailbox contents beyond what you voluntarily submit through this website.

data_use.title: 5. How we use email information
data_use.body: Information is used solely to operate the mail service described above, prevent abuse (including rate limiting), maintain service reliability, and comply with applicable law. We do not sell, rent, or trade your email address or message content to third parties.

storage_security.title: 6. Storage and security
storage_security.body: Contact and subscription records may be stored in secure application databases and email systems under our control. Access is limited to {owner} and systems required to operate the website. We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

google_limited_use.title: 7. Google API Services User Data Policy
google_limited_use.body: If Google user data is accessed through Google APIs, {siteName}'s use of that information complies with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Google user data is used only to provide or improve user-facing features of this site, is not transferred to third parties except as necessary to provide the service, and is not used for serving advertisements.

retention.title: 8. Retention
retention.body: Contact form correspondence is retained only as long as needed to respond to inquiries and maintain reasonable business records. Newsletter subscriber records are kept until you unsubscribe or request deletion. You may request removal of your data at any time using the contact details below.

your_rights.title: 9. Your rights
your_rights.body: Under applicable data protection law, including the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) in South Africa, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. Newsletter subscribers can stop receiving emails by using unsubscribe instructions in any message or by contacting us directly.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy

voiceAgentPrivacy.label: Legal
voiceAgentPrivacy.title: Voice Agent Privacy Policy
voiceAgentPrivacy.intro: This Voice Agent Privacy Policy describes how {owner} ({siteName}) collects and uses personal information when you talk to the NJMTECH AI voice agent, whether by calling or messaging our WhatsApp Business number (+27 79 434 7162) or by using a web-based voice demo linked from {siteUrl}.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: The NJMTECH voice agent is an automated assistant powered by artificial intelligence. It answers questions, looks up business information and can take actions such as creating bookings. When you call or message it, you are speaking to software, not a person. We process only the information needed to hold the conversation, complete your request and keep the service secure and reliable.

data_collected.title: 2. Information we collect
data_collected.body:
When you use the voice agent we may process:
• Your WhatsApp phone number, WhatsApp profile name and call or message identifiers provided by Meta.
• The audio of your call or voice note, which is converted to text in real time.
• Text transcripts of the conversation, including the agent's replies.
• Information you choose to share, such as your name, the service you want and a preferred date and time for a booking.
• Technical metadata such as call start and end times, delivery status and error logs.

how_it_works.title: 3. How the voice agent processes your conversation
how_it_works.body:
During a call or voice note:
• Your speech is transcribed to text by a speech-to-text provider.
• The transcript is sent to a large language model, which generates a reply and may request business information or an action (such as a booking) from our own systems.
• The reply is converted back into speech by a text-to-speech model running on cloud GPU infrastructure and played or sent back to you.

Call audio is processed as a live stream and is not recorded or stored by {siteName}. Transcripts and a short automated summary of each call are kept as described in the Retention section.

service_providers.title: 4. Service providers
service_providers.body:
We use the following providers to operate the voice agent. Each processes data on our behalf under its own terms and privacy policy:
• Meta Platforms (WhatsApp Business Platform) for WhatsApp calls and messages.
• Deepgram for real-time speech-to-text on calls.
• Cloudflare for secure network tunnelling and speech-to-text on voice notes (Workers AI).
• Anthropic for the Claude language model that generates replies.
• Modal for the cloud GPUs that run our text-to-speech model.

Some of these providers process data outside South Africa. Where personal information is transferred across borders, we rely on providers that apply safeguards consistent with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

data_use.title: 5. How we use your information
data_use.body:
We use your information to:
• Understand and answer your questions during the conversation.
• Complete actions you ask for, such as creating or confirming a booking.
• Follow up on your request where the agent could not resolve it.
• Monitor quality, fix errors and prevent abuse of the service.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information, we do not use it for advertising, and we do not use your conversations to train AI models.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body: Call audio is not stored. Conversation transcripts, call summaries and short message history used to keep context in WhatsApp conversations are kept only as long as needed to provide the service and handle follow-ups, and are periodically deleted. Booking details are kept for as long as reasonably required to deliver and administer the booking. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

storage_security.title: 7. Storage and security
storage_security.body: Information is stored in systems under our control and in the systems of the providers listed above. Access is limited to {owner} and the systems required to operate the voice agent. Connections between components are encrypted, and access keys are kept secret. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data.

your_rights.title: 8. Your rights and choices
your_rights.body: Under POPIA you may request access to, correction of or deletion of the personal information we hold about you, and object to its processing. You can stop using the voice agent at any time by ending the call or no longer messaging the number. To exercise your rights, contact us using the details below. You may also lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa.

children.title: 9. Children
children.body: The voice agent is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has used the service, contact us and we will delete the related information.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Voice Agent Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the voice agent after changes are posted means you accept the updated policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact

clippersTerms.label: Legal
clippersTerms.title: Clipper Terms of Service
clippersTerms.intro: These Terms of Service govern the Clipper app operated by {owner} ({siteName}). Clipper is a private publishing tool: it turns long-form videos into short vertical clips and, when an authorised operator chooses to, uploads them to social media accounts that {siteName} operates, such as the Shukela Clips (@shukela_clips) accounts on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram. By connecting an account to Clipper, using it, or sending us a video through an upload link, you agree to these terms.

service_description.title: 1. What Clipper does
service_description.body:
Clipper:
• Processes long-form videos supplied by its operators into short clips with captions.
• Uses automated tools, including speech-to-text and an AI model, to transcribe videos and suggest clip moments, titles, descriptions and hashtags. Operators review and can edit everything before it is published.
• Lets operators connect YouTube, TikTok and Instagram accounts and upload or post selected clips to those accounts, or send them to the platform's drafts.

Clipper never posts to a connected account without an operator choosing a clip and the destination.

eligibility.title: 2. Who may use Clipper
eligibility.body: The Clipper dashboard is restricted to operators authorised by {siteName}. Only accounts owned or managed by {siteName}, or by someone who has authorised {siteName} to publish on their behalf, may be connected. Anyone with an upload link may send us a video under section 3.

uploads.title: 3. Sending us a video
uploads.body:
Anyone with a Clipper upload link can send us a video. By uploading, you confirm that you made the video or own the rights to it, and you give {siteName} a non-exclusive, royalty-free permission to cut it into short clips, add captions, and publish those clips on the Shukela Clips accounts on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, with credit to you. You keep ownership of your video.

We review every upload and may decline any video without giving a reason. Don't upload content you don't have the rights to, or content that is unlawful, hateful, sexual, or that features people who haven't agreed to appear. If you change your mind, email us and we'll delete your video and take down clips made from it.

content_rights.title: 4. Content rights
content_rights.body:
Clipper may only be used with videos that:
• {siteName} or the account owner made and owns; or
• are published under a Creative Commons Attribution licence that allows commercial reuse and modification (Clipper checks the licence and requires a credit line); or
• the creator has given written permission to clip and repost, with credit.

Credit lines required by a licence or permission are added to captions automatically and cannot be removed. Operators are responsible for confirming rights before a source is processed. Rights holders who believe their content was used improperly can contact us (see Contact) and we will review it promptly and remove it where appropriate.

platform_terms.title: 5. Third-party platforms
platform_terms.body: When Clipper publishes to a platform, that platform's own terms and policies also apply, including the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms), TikTok's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines, TikTok's Music Usage Confirmation, and Instagram's Terms of Use and Community Guidelines. Clipper uses these platforms' official APIs and does not bypass their limits, review processes or privacy settings.

acceptable_use.title: 6. Acceptable use
acceptable_use.body:
You may not use Clipper to:
• Publish content you do not have the right to use.
• Publish misleading, spam, hateful, harassing or otherwise unlawful content.
• Misrepresent who created a video or remove required attribution.
• Attempt to access accounts, data or systems you are not authorised to use.

accounts.title: 7. Connected accounts
accounts.body: Connecting an account authorises Clipper to perform only the actions you approve on the platform's consent screen, such as uploading videos and reading basic profile information. You can disconnect an account at any time from the Clipper dashboard, and revoke Clipper's access from the platform's own settings (for example, Google Account permissions or TikTok's Manage app permissions).

availability.title: 8. Availability
availability.body: Clipper is provided as is. It may be changed, suspended or discontinued at any time, and platform API changes or limits can affect what it can do.

disclaimer.title: 9. Disclaimer and liability
disclaimer.body: To the extent permitted by law, {siteName} is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of Clipper, including content removed by a platform, account restrictions, or lost revenue. governing_law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms, or a rights or takedown request: {email}.

clippersPolicy.label: Legal
clippersPolicy.title: Clipper Privacy Policy
clippersPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information the Clipper app, operated by {owner} ({siteName}), collects and how it is used. Clipper turns long videos into short clips and publishes them to social media accounts that {siteName} operates, such as Shukela Clips (@shukela_clips). People can also send us videos through a shared upload link.

data_collected.title: 1. Information we collect
data_collected.body:
When an account is connected, Clipper receives and stores:
• Access and refresh tokens issued by the platform (YouTube/Google, TikTok, Instagram), so it can post on the account's behalf.
• Basic account information: the account or channel ID, display name and username or handle.
• For TikTok, creator information needed to post (nickname, username, available privacy options, interaction settings and maximum video length).
• Records of what Clipper posted: the clip, caption, privacy setting, the platform's post or video ID and link, status and any error message.

Clipper also stores the source videos operators submit, their transcripts and the clips produced from them. Operators sign in to the dashboard through Cloudflare Access, which records their email address.

uploads.title: 2. Videos sent through an upload link
uploads.body:
{siteName} can share a link that lets people send us a video without an account. When you upload through it, we collect:
• The video file you upload.
• Your name and email address, and optionally a title, a credit line (such as your handle) and notes.
• Your confirmation that you own the rights to the video and allow it to be clipped and published with credit.
• A one-way, salted hash of your IP address, used only to limit how many uploads one network can make in an hour. We don't store your IP address itself.
• The result of a Cloudflare Turnstile bot check, which Cloudflare processes to tell people from automated scripts.

We use these details to review your video, decide whether to use it, credit you, contact you about it, and keep a record of your permission. Uploaders can't see any other part of Clipper.

data_use.title: 3. How we use it
data_use.body: We use this information only to operate Clipper: to create clips, publish or upload them when an operator chooses to, show the result and link in the dashboard, and keep the service secure. We do not sell personal information, use it for advertising, or share it with anyone except the service providers below. Clipper does not read or store other users' content, followers, messages or analytics.

google.title: 4. YouTube and Google data
google.body: Clipper uses YouTube API Services to upload videos and to identify the connected channel. Its use of information received from Google APIs follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. See the Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) for how Google handles data. You can revoke Clipper's access at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions.

service_providers.title: 5. Service providers
service_providers.body:
Clipper runs on:
• Cloudflare (dashboard and upload page hosting, database, video storage, sign-in, and the Turnstile bot check).
• Amazon Web Services (video processing on GPU servers, and an AI model via Amazon Bedrock to transcribe videos and suggest clips).
• Infisical (encrypted storage of application secrets).
• Google/YouTube, TikTok and Meta/Instagram, through their official APIs, when content is published.
Each provider processes data under its own terms and privacy policy.

storage_security.title: 6. Storage and security
storage_security.body: Account tokens are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before they are stored. The dashboard is only reachable by authorised operators, and connections use HTTPS. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect the information we hold.

retention.title: 7. Retention
retention.body:
Tokens and account details are kept until the account is disconnected in the dashboard, which deletes them. Post records are kept as a history of what was published. Source videos are deleted from storage after 30 days; finished clips are kept until an operator deletes them.

Videos sent through an upload link are deleted straight away if we decline them. Unfinished uploads are removed within a day. If we use a video, your name, email, credit line and rights confirmation are kept as the record of permission for as long as clips made from it are published.

your_rights.title: 8. Your choices and rights
your_rights.body: You can disconnect an account in the Clipper dashboard or revoke access from the platform's settings at any time. If you sent us a video, you can ask us to delete it, or to take down clips made from it, by emailing {email}. Under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) you may ask what personal information we hold, and ask us to correct or delete it, by contacting us.

children.title: 9. Children
children.body: Clipper is not intended for children and is not used to collect information from them.

changes.title: 10. Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.
